# longstaff_schwartz_price: American put under Heston, kappa 5, theta 0.16, xi 0.9, rho 0.1, rate 0.1 (mu = rate), T 0.25 years, K 10.
# One simulation per v0: 131072 paths, 64 steps and exercise dates (0.0039 years each), QuadraticExponential with martingale correction, QuasiRandom seed 20261101 with 16 replicates, degree 3. Each spot S0 is priced from S0 = 10 by scaling: strike K * 10 / S0, price times S0 / 10.
